problem_space.description: High-stakes, complex and time-sensitive decisions (money, career, projects, markets) lack an explainable, structured AI framework for normal users.
limitations: weak support for what-if exploration and counterfactuals
poor localization for Bangladesh and similar markets
no unified, Google-Maps-like tool for decisions across domains

key_trends: rapid growth of AI apps and decision-support tools
dominance of NLP chatbots and recommendation engines
rising demand for explainable and trustworthy AI

region_trends: Smart Bangladesh 2041 and government support for ICT
growing startup ecosystem and foreign investment

primary_segments: households planning education, migration and savings
needs: clear and transparent reasoning behind recommendations
fast, up-to-date insights for time-sensitive choices
trust_barriers: fear of AI hallucinations and hidden biases
belief that serious decisions must be done by humans

product_niche.core_value_prop: An explainable decision companion that guides users through a structured decision pipeline with interactive what-if exploration.
differentiation: built-in explainability and counterfactual scenario exploration
continuous evaluation using an open test suite and telemetry
use_cases: project and roadmap planning for small teams

user_controls: ability to pause or override the AI

assumptions: 5-10 percent of global AI apps spend is addressable by explainable decision support
initial focus on English and Bengali-speaking serious AI users
0.1-0.3 percent of SAM captured within 3-5 years

go_to_market.entry_beachhead: Bangladesh knowledge workers and students using a mobile-first decision assistant
revenue_streams: B2B and government licensing or white-labelling
hosted evaluation and insights services based on the decision test suite

roadmap.phase_1: Prototype assistant, decision schema and small test suite; launch closed beta in Bangladesh (0-12 months)
roadmap.phase_2: Scale features, add domain modules and expand to regional and global users (1-3 years)
roadmap.phase_3: Mature into a widely used decision infrastructure with strong research collaborations and open benchmarks (3-7 years)
